description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for handling recipe browsing, viewing, importing, and listing within a web application. It includes methods for listing recipes, viewing a specific recipe, importing recipes, and managing related project and user data.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Browse::Recipe
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for browsing and managing recipes within the application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing recipes, including filtering based on user permissions and project associations, and prepares recipe data with URLs for display.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the recipe context by fetching a specific recipe from the database and preparing it for further actions.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Prepares the interface for importing recipes from other projects, listing available projects for import.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific recipe, including ingredients and related project data.
